Tri-coupled composite

The same cells rendered by all three mechanics paradigms, coloured by cell type (same palette as the stand-alone sims). Vertex owns shape, munk owns position (three-way consensus), CPM owns area. The Coupled overlay shows one set of cells with all three on top of each other: CPM fill, vertex outline, center-based ring.

Cell types: AB
